convert_bros_checkpoint: convert a BROS original checkpoint to a PyTorch HuggingFace model and save or push to hub
convert_state_dict: convert a BROS original state dict by renaming keys and removing ignored embedding keys
run_convert_bros_cli: run the BROS checkpoint conversion CLI with a model name, output path, and optional hub push
rename_key: rename BROS state dict keys from original repo naming to HuggingFace naming convention
get_configs: load a BROS config from a pretrained model name for checkpoint conversion
